style: Chinese xianxia manga style, dramatic lighting, detailed character art, dynamic action poses

韩立.appearance: a handsome young man with sharp determined eyes, long black hair tied in a topknot with a jade hairpin, wearing a dark blue Daoist robe with silver cloud patterns, lean athletic build, calm but intense expression
韩立.personality: 沉稳内敛，极度谨慎，心思缜密

旁白.voice_name: 儒雅逸辰（沉稳大气仙侠叙事）

墨大夫.appearance: an old mysterious man with thin white beard, cunning narrow eyes, wearing tattered grey robes, hunched posture but radiating hidden power, sinister smile

南宫婉.appearance: a stunningly beautiful woman with long flowing white hair, ethereal ice-blue eyes, wearing elegant white and light blue fairy robes that flow like water, graceful and cold demeanor

厉飞雨.appearance: a rugged muscular man with short spiky hair, battle scars on face, wearing heavy black armor with red trim, fierce aggressive expression, broadsword on back

雷万鹤.appearance: a fat elderly cultivator with round face, kind but often shocked expression, wearing brown and gold robes

聂盈.appearance: a beautiful female cultivator with elegant features, wearing white robes, warm and caring expression
